sections.title: Imports for account menu

sections.why: The menu needs its own parts, the signed-in user details, and a way to move to other pages.

sections.name: UserNav
sections.title: Account menu with logout
sections.what: Shows a round button with the user's first initial. Opening it shows the user's name and email, then links to Profile, Settings and Notifications, and a Log out option. Logging out clears the sign-in and sends the user to the login page. If the user details are missing, it shows placeholder text and a demo email.
sections.why: Gives one place for account pages and sign-out, available from every screen.
sections.watch_out: The placeholder email patient at maate dot health is shown when no user is loaded, so it should not be mistaken for a real account. The logout happens in the store before the page change, so the store must clear the session correctly.

summary: The round avatar button in the top bar that opens a menu with the user's name and email, links to Profile, Settings and Notifications, and a log out option.
purpose: Gives quick access to account pages and to logging out.
why: Reason not stated beyond the header. Likely reason: keeps account options in one place.
how: Reads the user and the logout action from the auth store. The avatar shows the first letter of the user's name. The menu shows the name and email, or fallback text if they are missing. Each link goes to its page. Log out clears the store, then goes to the login page.
inputs: The user object and the logout action from the auth store.
risks: When no user is loaded, the menu shows a made-up name and the email patient@maate.health, which could be mistaken for a real account. Whether the server session ends depends on the logout action in the store, which is not shown here.
debug: If the name or email is wrong, check the user object in the auth store. If logout leaves the user signed in, check the logout action in the store. If a link fails, check the path.
